ambiguities_or_notes: The page marker, printed heading, fable label, and complete two-paragraph narrative are represented; the exact source SHA-256 matched the mounted audited Russian snapshot.

The Russian file metadata calls the work «Птицы в сети», while its body heading is «ПТИЦЫ И СЕТИ». Official volume 21 likewise prints «ПТИЦЫ И СЕТИ» as the heading and table-of-contents title, while its later commentary uses «Птицы в сети». The English publication heading therefore follows the body as 'The Birds and the Nets'; the stable Russian metadata/path is left untouched.
«накрыл много птиц» is rendered plainly as 'caught many birds' rather than importing a particular trapping mechanism beyond the nets already named.

«птицы потянули на ночлег, каждая в свою сторону» is kept physically as 'the birds began pulling toward their roosts, each in its own direction', because their contrary pulling is the mechanism of the fable's ending.
The final sequence—forest, swamp, field, fall to the ground, hunter takes them—is complete and in source order. Reverse target-to-source audit found no substantive omission or unsupported addition.
